newsitem.title: USA: Zaxis patents genetic marking gels.
newsitem.headline: Zaxis patents genetic marking gels.

text.p: Zaxis International Inc on Monday said it was granted a U.S. patent on multi-gradient gels that help identify genetic markers and assess cardiovascular risk.
Its Lipoprotein Assay Kit, the first product using this technology, is already being marketed, Zaxis said.
The U.S. Food and Drug Administration recently granted market clearance for the kit, allowing it to be sold for use in clinical diagnostic applications, Zaxis said.
The system also includes proprietary software for scanning and analyzing multiple blood serum samples simultaneously, Zaxis said. Zaxis stock closed unchanged at 5-1/2 on the Nasdaq.
The system reads lipoproteins to help assess cardiac risk and can help assess prescribed treatments for those with atherosclerotic disease, Zaxis said.
The gels can also be used in research, Zaxis said, adding it planned to expand applications for the technology.
Zaxis said the patent covers use of any gradient gel with two or more functional gradients manufactured with any gel polymer.
